source_of_truth: modules/blender/geometry.py::pair_timeline emits the first seven types today. asymmetric_rebound is NEW in this pack and is a module-versioned supplement, never a silent field on a canonical InteractionEvent.
honesty_rules: Gap and area are geometric proxies. No impulse, force, mass or energy is inferred.
Proximity is not impact: a near miss requires an independent bracketed positive minimum plus a certified no-tunnelling segment.
Unavailable measures are null with a reason. Never a fabricated zero.
These are declared creative mappings, not acoustics and not emotion detection.

lane_vocabulary.note: Lanes remain independent controls. A mapping may not change key, gain, articulation or expression preset as a side effect.

events.emitted_by: pair_timeline strict-turn bracket, onset at bracket start, duration to the minimum
events.notes: Ornament density rises toward the minimum. Do not pre-announce the outcome: an approach that ends in a near miss must sound identical to one that ends in contact until the moment of resolution.

events.emitted_by: pair_timeline when the bracketed minimum gap stays positive AND every segment is certified against tunnelling
events.musical_intent: Withheld resolution. The signature sound of this project.
events.required_behaviour: Leave the prevailing harmony unresolved for at least one beat past the minimum (sus4 or an upper structure with the 3rd withheld), then release without a downbeat accent. A near miss must never produce a contact-like transient; the absence of the hit is the musical event.

events.emitted_by: pair_timeline after the bracketed minimum, running to the recovery sample
events.notes: Density decays monotonically across the episode. Do not restate the approach material in retrograde; thin it.

events.emitted_by: pair_timeline first sample with gap <= tolerance
events.foley: Independent scene-second event stream. Foley is not quantized to ticks and is not part of the soundtrack lane budget.

events.emitted_by: pair_timeline for a contiguous run of non-positive gaps
events.notes: A low damped pedal or brush sustain. No repeated re-articulation: a sustain is one decision, not a tremolo.

events.emitted_by: pair_timeline first sample after the contact run
pair_timeline swept-sphere test, for contacts that occur entirely between two samples
events.musical_intent: Same as contact_onset, with explicit sub-sample provenance.
events.driver: clamp(|relative closing speed at sweep root| / contact_ref_speed_m_s, 0, 1)
events.deduplication: A collision within contact_dedupe_s of a contact_onset for the same pair is one musical event, not two. Keep the swept timestamp and record method='swept_sphere_exact'.

events.status: NEW in this pack. Derived descriptor, module-versioned supplement.
events.emitted_by: Derived in node 01 from an existing contact_onset or collision plus ObjectState geometry. Never emitted by canonical pair_timeline without a version bump.
events.musical_intent: A small object bounces off a large one: the small body speaks, the large body only registers.

preconditions.trigger: a contact_onset or collision for pair (a, b)
preconditions.area_ratio: max(area_m2) / min(area_m2) >= rebound_min_area_ratio, both areas non-null from evaluated meshes

events.musical_rule: The rebounding object's motif takes a grace-note or appoggiatura figure at the contact tick, register biased up by curve(register, area_ratio), velocity scaled by speed_retention. The anchor object gets at most one low damped note and never a melodic figure. A rebound chain (multiple rebounds inside rebound_window_s) decays in velocity and must not increase event density beyond the plan's budget.
forbidden: asserting mass, momentum, restitution coefficient or energy
emitting when either evaluated area is null
emitting without a triggering contact_onset or collision
using screen-space size instead of world-space evaluated area

global_budget.fallback: Any event whose driver inputs are null or out of coverage falls back to the unmodified score and is logged with a reason. Silence on missing data, never an invented default.
